AI Agentic Interactions: From GUI to Real World EnvironmentAI 智能体交互：从图形界面到真实世界环境

AI agents are increasingly performing complex tasks by interacting with digital interfaces and the physical world. Their ability to perceive, process, and act within these varied environments is fundamentally transforming automation, human-computer interaction, and intelligent systems. This chapter explores how agents interact with computers and their environments, highlighting advancements and projects.

AI 智能体正越来越多地通过与数字界面和物理世界的交互来执行复杂任务。它们在这些各异环境中感知、处理和行动的能力，正在从根本上改变自动化、人机交互和智能系统。本章探讨智能体如何与计算机及其环境交互，并重点介绍相关进展与项目。

Interaction: Agents with Computers交互：智能体与计算机

The evolution of AI from conversational partners to active, task-oriented agents is being driven by Agent-Computer Interfaces (ACIs). These interfaces allow AI to interact directly with a computer's Graphical User Interface (GUI), enabling it to perceive and manipulate visual elements like icons and buttons just as a human would. This new method moves beyond the rigid, developer-dependent scripts of traditional automation that relied on APIs and system calls. By using the visual “front door” of software, AI can now automate complex digital tasks in a more flexible and powerful way, a process that involves several key stages:

AI 正从“对话伙伴”演变为“主动的、面向任务的智能体”，这一演进由智能体—计算机接口（Agent-Computer Interfaces, ACI）推动。这些接口让 AI 能够直接与计算机的图形用户界面（GUI）交互，使其像人一样感知并操纵图标、按钮等视觉元素。这种新方法超越了传统自动化中那种死板的、依赖开发者、靠 API 和系统调用的脚本。通过走软件的视觉“正门”，AI 如今能以更灵活、更强大的方式自动化复杂的数字任务，这一过程包含几个关键阶段：

  • Visual Perception: The agent first captures a visual representation of the screen, essentially taking a screenshot.视觉感知：智能体首先捕获屏幕的视觉表示，本质上就是截屏。
  • GUI Element Recognition: It then analyzes this image to distinguish between various GUI elements. It must learn to “see” the screen not as a mere collection of pixels, but as a structured layout with interactiveGUI 元素识别：接着它分析这张图像，区分出各种 GUI 元素。它必须学会“看”屏幕——不把它当作像素的简单集合，而是当作一个由可交互组件构成的、有结构的布局
— 原书第 387 页 —
  • components, discerning a clickable “Submit” button from a static banner image or an editable text field from a simple label.——从而分辨出可点击的“提交”按钮与静态横幅图片、可编辑文本框与普通标签。
  • Contextual Interpretation: The ACI module, acting as a bridge between the visual data and the agent's core intelligence (often a Large Language Model or LLM), interprets these elements within the context of the task. It understands that a magnifying glass icon typically means “search” or that a series of radio buttons represents a choice. This module is crucial for enhancing the LLM's reasoning, allowing it to form a plan based on visual evidence.上下文解读：ACI 模块充当视觉数据与智能体核心智能（通常是大语言模型 LLM）之间的桥梁，在任务语境中解读这些元素。它明白放大镜图标通常意味着“搜索”，或一组单选按钮代表一个选择。这个模块对于增强 LLM 的推理至关重要，让它能基于视觉证据形成计划。
  • Dynamic Action and Response: The agent then programmatically controls the mouse and keyboard to execute its plan—clicking, typing, scrolling, and dragging. Critically, it must constantly monitor the screen for visual feedback, dynamically responding to changes, loading screens, pop-up notifications, or errors to successfully navigate multi-step workflows.动态行动与响应：随后智能体以编程方式控制鼠标和键盘来执行计划——点击、输入、滚动、拖拽。关键在于，它必须持续监视屏幕上的视觉反馈，动态地对变化、加载画面、弹出通知或错误做出反应，以顺利走完多步工作流。

This technology is no longer theoretical. Several leading AI labs have developed functional agents that demonstrate the power of GUI interaction:

这项技术已不再停留于理论。几家领先的 AI 实验室已经开发出可用的智能体，展示了 GUI 交互的威力：

ChatGPT Operator (OpenAI): Envisioned as a digital partner, ChatGPT Operator is designed to automate tasks across a wide range of applications directly from the desktop. It understands on-screen elements, enabling it to perform actions like transferring data from a spreadsheet into a customer relationship management (CRM) platform, booking a complex travel itinerary across airline and hotel websites, or filling out detailed online forms without needing specialized API access for each service. This makes it a universally adaptable tool aimed at boosting both personal and enterprise productivity by taking over repetitive digital chores.

ChatGPT Operator（OpenAI）：它被设想为一位数字伙伴，旨在直接在桌面端跨各种应用自动化任务。它能理解屏幕元素，从而执行诸如把电子表格中的数据转移到客户关系管理（CRM）平台、在多家航空和酒店网站上预订一条复杂的行程、或填写详细在线表单等动作——而无需为每项服务专门申请 API 接入。这使它成为一个通用适配的工具，旨在通过接管重复性数字杂务来提升个人与企业的生产力。

— 原书第 388 页 —

Google's Project Mariner is designed to understand a user's intent and autonomously carry out web-based tasks on their behalf. For example, a user could ask it to find three apartments for rent within a specific budget and neighborhood; Mariner would then navigate to real estate websites, apply the filters, browse the listings, and extract the relevant information into a document. This project represents Google's exploration into creating a truly helpful and “agentive” web experience where the browser actively works for the user.

Google 的 Project Mariner 旨在理解用户意图，并代表用户自主完成基于网页的任务。例如，用户可以让它在特定预算和街区内找三套出租公寓；Mariner 随后会导航到房地产网站、套用筛选条件、浏览房源，并把相关信息提取到一份文档中。这个项目代表了 Google 在探索创造一种真正有用、“有智能体能动性”的网页体验——浏览器主动为用户干活。

Anthropic's Computer Use: This feature empowers Anthropic's AI model, Claude, to become a direct user of a computer's desktop environment. By capturing screenshots to perceive the screen and programmatically controlling the mouse and keyboard, Claude can orchestrate workflows that span multiple, unconnected applications. A user could ask it to analyze data in a PDF report, open a spreadsheet application to perform calculations on that data, generate a chart, and then paste that chart into an email draft—a sequence of tasks that previously required constant human input.

Anthropic 的 Computer Use（计算机使用）：这项功能让 Anthropic 的 AI 模型 Claude 成为计算机桌面环境的直接使用者。通过截屏感知屏幕、并以编程方式控制鼠标和键盘，Claude 能够编排横跨多个互不关联应用的工作流。用户可以让它分析一份 PDF 报告中的数据、打开电子表格应用对这些数据做计算、生成一张图表，再把图表粘贴进一封邮件草稿——这一连串任务在过去需要人持续介入。

Browser Use: This is an open-source library that provides a high-level API for programmatic browser automation. It enables AI agents to interface with web pages by granting them access to and control over the Document Object Model (DOM). The API abstracts the intricate, low-level commands of browser control protocols into a more simplified and intuitive set of functions. This allows an agent to perform complex sequences of actions, including data extraction from nested elements, form submissions, and automated navigation across multiple pages. As a result, the library facilitates the transformation of unstructured web data into a structured format that an AI agent can systematically process and utilize for analysis or decision-making.

Browser Use：这是一个开源库，为编程式浏览器自动化提供高层 API。它通过让 AI 智能体能够访问并控制文档对象模型（DOM），来与网页对接。该 API 把浏览器控制协议中复杂、低层的命令，抽象成一套更简洁、更直观的函数。这让智能体能够执行复杂的动作序列，包括从嵌套元素中抽取数据、提交表单、以及跨多页自动导航。于是，这个库促成了把非结构化网页数据变换为结构化格式，供 AI 智能体系统地处理，并用于分析或决策。

Interaction: Agents with the Environment交互：智能体与环境

Beyond the confines of a computer screen, AI agents are increasingly designed to interact with complex, dynamic environments, often mirroring the real world. This requires sophisticated perception, reasoning, and actuation capabilities.

在计算机屏幕之外，AI 智能体正越来越多地被设计成与复杂、动态的环境交互——这些环境往往映照真实世界。这需要复杂的感知、推理和执行能力。

Google's Project Astra is a prime example of an initiative pushing the boundaries of agent interaction with the environment. Astra aims to create a universal AI agent that is helpful in everyday life, leveraging multimodal inputs (sight, sound, voice) and outputs to understand and interact with the world contextually. This project focuses on rapid understanding, reasoning, and response, allowing the agent to “see” and “hear” its surroundings through

Google 的 Project Astra 是推动“智能体与环境交互”边界的一个典型范例。Astra 旨在创造一个在日常生活中有用的通用 AI 智能体，利用多模态输入（视觉、声音、语音）和输出，来在语境中理解世界并与之交互。该项目聚焦于快速理解、推理和响应，让智能体能够通过

cameras and microphones and engage in natural conversation while providing real-time assistance. Astra's vision is an agent that can seamlessly assist users with tasks ranging from finding lost items to debugging code, by understanding the environment it observes. This moves beyond simple voice commands to a truly embodied understanding of the user's immediate physical context.

摄像头和麦克风“看”和“听”周围环境，并在提供实时帮助的同时进行自然对话。Astra 的愿景是：一个智能体通过理解它所观察到的环境，无缝地协助用户完成从找失物到调试代码等各种任务。这超越了简单的语音指令，走向对用户当下物理情境的一种真正具身化的理解。

Google's Gemini Live, transforms standard AI interactions into a fluid and dynamic conversation. Users can speak to the AI and receive responses in a natural-sounding voice with minimal delay, and can even interrupt or change topics mid-sentence, prompting the AI to adapt immediately. The interface expands beyond voice, allowing users to incorporate visual information by using their phone's camera, sharing their screen, or uploading files for a more context-aware discussion. More advanced versions can even perceive a user's tone of voice and intelligently filter out irrelevant background noise to better understand the conversation. These capabilities combine to create rich interactions, such as receiving live instructions on a task by simply pointing a camera at it.

Google 的 Gemini Live 把标准的 AI 交互变成流畅、动态的对话。用户可以对 AI 说话，并以极小延迟、用自然的声音收到回应；甚至可以在句子说到一半时打断或换话题，促使 AI 立即适应。该界面超越了语音，让用户能借助手机摄像头、共享屏幕或上传文件来加入视觉信息，进行更具上下文感知的讨论。更高级的版本甚至能感知用户的语气，智能地滤掉无关背景噪音，以更好地理解对话。这些能力结合起来，创造出丰富的交互——比如只要把摄像头对准某个任务，就能收到关于它的实时指导。

OpenAI's GPT-4o model is an alternative designed for “omni” interaction, meaning it can reason across voice, vision, and text. It processes these inputs with low latency that mirrors human response times, which allows for real-time conversations. For example, users can show the AI a live video feed to ask questions about what is happening, or use it for language translation. OpenAI provides developers with a “Realtime API” to build applications requiring low-latency, speech-to-speech interactions.

OpenAI 的 GPT-4o 模型是另一种选择，它为“全模态”（omni）交互而设计，意味着它能跨语音、视觉和文本进行推理。它以接近人类反应时间的低延迟处理这些输入，从而支持实时对话。例如，用户可以把实时视频画面展示给 AI，就正在发生的事情提问，或用它做语言翻译。OpenAI 为开发者提供了一个“Realtime API”，用于构建需要低延迟、语音到语音交互的应用。

OpenAI's ChatGPT Agent represents a significant architectural advancement over its predecessors, featuring an integrated framework of new capabilities. Its design incorporates several key functional modalities: the capacity for autonomous navigation of the live internet for real-time data extraction, the ability to dynamically generate and execute computational code for tasks like data analysis, and the functionality to interface directly with third-party software applications. The synthesis of these functions allows the agent to orchestrate and complete complex, sequential workflows from a singular user directive. It can therefore autonomously manage entire processes, such as performing market analysis and generating a corresponding presentation, or planning logistical arrangements and executing the necessary transactions. In parallel with the launch, OpenAI has proactively addressed the emergent safety considerations inherent in such a system. An accompanying “System Card” delineates the potential operational hazards associated with an AI capable of performing actions online, acknowledging the new vectors for misuse. To mitigate these risks, the agent's architecture includes engineered safeguards, such as requiring explicit user authorization for certain classes of actions and

OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Agent 相比其前代是一次重大的架构进步，具备一个集成了多项新能力的框架。其设计融入了几种关键功能模态：自主导航实时互联网以抽取实时数据的能力、为数据分析等任务动态生成并执行计算代码的能力、以及直接与第三方软件应用对接的功能。这些功能的综合，让智能体能够从单一用户指令出发，编排并完成复杂的、顺序执行的工作流。因此它可以自主管理整个流程，比如做市场分析并生成相应的演示文稿，或规划后勤安排并执行必要的交易。在发布的同时，OpenAI 也主动应对了这类系统内在涌现的安全考量。配套的“系统卡”勾勒了一个能在线执行动作的 AI 所伴随的潜在运行风险，并承认了新的滥用途径。为缓解这些风险，智能体的架构内置了工程化的防护措施，例如对某些类别的动作要求用户明确授权，以及

deploying robust content filtering mechanisms. The company is now engaging its initial user base to further refine these safety protocols through a feedback-driven, iterative process.

Seeing AI, a complimentary mobile application from Microsoft, empowers individuals who are blind or have low vision by offering real-time narration of their surroundings. The app leverages artificial intelligence through the device's camera to identify and describe various elements, including objects, text, and even people. Its core functionalities encompass reading documents, recognizing currency, identifying products through barcodes, and describing scenes and colors. By providing enhanced access to visual information, Seeing AI ultimately fosters greater independence for visually impaired users.

Seeing AI 是微软推出的一款免费移动应用，它通过对周围环境进行实时语音播报，赋能盲人和低视力人士。该应用借助设备摄像头、利用人工智能来识别并描述各种元素，包括物体、文字甚至人。其核心功能包括朗读文档、识别货币、通过条形码识别商品，以及描述场景和颜色。通过提供对视觉信息的增强访问，Seeing AI 最终帮助视障用户获得更大的独立性。

Anthropic's Claude 4 Series: Anthropic's Claude 4 is another alternative with capabilities for advanced reasoning and analysis. Though historically focused on text, Claude 4 includes robust vision capabilities, allowing it to process information from images, charts, and documents. The model is suited for handling complex, multi-step tasks and providing detailed analysis. While the real-time conversational aspect is not its primary focus compared to other models, its underlying intelligence is designed for building highly capable AI agents.

Anthropic 的 Claude 4 系列：Anthropic 的 Claude 4 是另一种选择，具备高级推理和分析能力。尽管历史上专注于文本，Claude 4 也包含健壮的视觉能力，能处理来自图像、图表和文档的信息。该模型适合处理复杂的多步任务并提供详细分析。虽然与其他模型相比，实时对话并非它的主要关注点，但其底层智能是为构建高性能 AI 智能体而设计的。

Vibe Coding: Intuitive Development with AI氛围编码：用 AI 做直觉式开发

Beyond direct interaction with GUIs and the physical world, a new paradigm is emerging in how developers build software with AI: “vibe coding.” This approach moves away from precise, step-by-step instructions and instead relies on a more intuitive, conversational, and iterative interaction between the developer and an AI coding assistant. The developer provides a high-level goal, a desired “vibe,” or a general direction, and the AI generates code to match.

除了与 GUI 和物理世界直接交互之外，开发者用 AI 构建软件的方式中正浮现一种新范式：“氛围编码”（vibe coding）。这种方式摆脱了精确、逐步的指令，转而依赖开发者与 AI 编程助手之间更直觉、更对话式、更迭代的交互。开发者给出一个高层目标、一种期望的“氛围”或一个大致方向，AI 就生成匹配的代码。

This process is characterized by:

这个过程有如下特征：

  • Conversational Prompts: Instead of writing detailed specifications, a developer might say, “Create a simple, modern-looking landing page for a new app,” or, “Refactor this function to be more Pythonic and readable.” The AI interprets the “vibe” of “modern” or “Pythonic” and generates the corresponding code.对话式提示：开发者不必写详细规格，而是可能说“为一个新应用做一个简洁、看起来现代的落地页”，或“把这个函数重构得更 Pythonic、更易读”。AI 解读“现代”或“Pythonic”这种“氛围”，并生成相应代码。
  • Iterative Refinement: The initial output from the AI is often a starting point. The developer then provides feedback in natural language, such as, “That's a good start, but can you make the buttons blue?” or, “Add some迭代精修：AI 的初始输出往往只是一个起点。开发者随后用自然语言给出反馈，比如“开头不错，但能把按钮弄成蓝色吗？”或“给它加一些

  • error handling to that.” This back-and-forth continues until the code meets the developer's expectations.错误处理。” 这样来回反复，直到代码达到开发者的期望。
  • Creative Partnership: In vibe coding, the AI acts as a creative partner, suggesting ideas and solutions that the developer may not have considered. This can accelerate the development process and lead to more innovative outcomes.创造性伙伴：在氛围编码中，AI 扮演创造性伙伴，提出开发者可能没想到的点子和方案。这能加速开发过程，并带来更具创新性的成果。
  • Focus on “What” not “How”: The developer focuses on the desired outcome (the “what”) and leaves the implementation details (the “how”) to the AI. This allows for rapid prototyping and exploration of different approaches without getting bogged down in boilerplate code.关注“做什么”而非“怎么做”：开发者专注于期望的结果（“做什么”），把实现细节（“怎么做”）交给 AI。这使得快速原型制作和对不同方法的探索成为可能，而不必陷入样板代码的泥潭。
  • Optional Memory Banks: To maintain context across longer interactions, developers can use “memory banks” to store key information, preferences, or constraints. For example, a developer might save a specific coding style or a set of project requirements to the AI's memory, ensuring that future code generations remain consistent with the established “vibe” without needing to repeat the instructions.可选的记忆库：为在更长的交互中保持上下文，开发者可以用“记忆库”来存储关键信息、偏好或约束。例如，开发者可以把某种特定编码风格或一组项目要求存入 AI 的记忆，确保未来生成的代码与既定“氛围”保持一致，而无需重复指令。

Vibe coding is becoming increasingly popular with the rise of powerful AI models like GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini, which are integrated into development environments. These tools are not just auto-completing code; they are actively participating in the creative process of software development, making it more accessible and efficient. This new way of working is changing the nature of software engineering, emphasizing creativity and high-level thinking over rote memorization of syntax and APIs.

随着 GPT-4、Claude、Gemini 等强大 AI 模型被集成进开发环境，氛围编码正变得越来越流行。这些工具不只是自动补全代码；它们在积极参与软件开发的创造过程，让开发更易上手、更高效。这种新的工作方式正在改变软件工程的本质：强调创造力和高层思考，而非死记语法和 API。

Key Takeaways要点回顾

  • AI agents are evolving from simple automation to visually controlling software through graphical user interfaces, much like a human would.AI 智能体正从简单自动化，演进为像人一样通过图形用户界面来视觉化地控制软件。
  • The next frontier is real-world interaction, with projects like Google's Astra using cameras and microphones to see, hear, and understand their physical surroundings.下一个前沿是真实世界交互：像 Google Astra 这样的项目用摄像头和麦克风去看、去听、去理解它们所处的物理环境。
  • Leading technology companies are converging these digital and physical capabilities to create universal AI assistants that operate seamlessly across both domains.领先科技公司正把这些数字与物理能力融合起来，创造在两个领域都能无缝运作的通用 AI 助手。
  • This shift is creating a new class of proactive, context-aware AI companions capable of assisting with a vast range of tasks in users' daily lives.这一转变正在催生一类新的、主动的、具备上下文感知能力的 AI 伙伴，能够协助用户日常生活中的大量任务。

Conclusion小结

Agents are undergoing a significant transformation, moving from basic automation to sophisticated interaction with both digital and physical environments. By leveraging visual perception to operate Graphical User Interfaces, these agents can now manipulate software just as a human would, bypassing the need for traditional APIs. Major technology labs are pioneering this space with agents capable of automating complex, multi-application workflows directly on a user's desktop. Simultaneously, the next frontier is expanding into the physical world, with initiatives like Google's Project Astra using cameras and microphones to contextually engage with their surroundings. These advanced systems are designed for multimodal, real-time understanding that mirrors human interaction.

智能体正在经历一场重大转变：从基础自动化，走向与数字和物理环境都进行复杂交互。通过利用视觉感知来操作图形用户界面，这些智能体如今能像人一样操纵软件，绕开了对传统 API 的依赖。各大科技实验室正在这个领域开拓，其智能体能够直接在用户桌面上自动化复杂的、跨多应用的工作流。与此同时，下一个前沿正向物理世界扩展——像 Google Project Astra 这样的项目用摄像头和麦克风，在语境中与周围环境互动。这些先进系统为多模态、实时的理解而设计，模拟人类交互。

The ultimate vision is a convergence of these digital and physical capabilities, creating universal AI assistants that operate seamlessly across all of a user's environments. This evolution is also reshaping software creation itself through “vibe coding,” a more intuitive and conversational partnership between developers and AI. This new method prioritizes high-level goals and creative intent, allowing developers to focus on the desired outcome rather than implementation details. This shift accelerates development and fosters innovation by treating AI as a creative partner. Ultimately, these advancements are paving the way for a new era of proactive, context-aware AI companions capable of assisting with a vast array of tasks in our daily lives.

终极愿景是这些数字与物理能力的融合，创造出在用户所有环境中都能无缝运作的通用 AI 助手。这一演进也正在通过“氛围编码”重塑软件创造本身——开发者与 AI 之间一种更直觉、更对话式的伙伴关系。这种新方法把高层目标和创造意图放在优先位置，让开发者专注于期望的结果而非实现细节。这一转变通过把 AI 当作创造性伙伴来加速开发、孕育创新。归根结底，这些进步正在为一个新时代铺路：主动、具备上下文感知能力的 AI 伙伴，能够协助我们日常生活中的大量任务。
